scientific_integrity: Exact complete enumeration, independent finite-field Jacobian implementation, and geometric sufficiency via the binary Pfaffian parameter bound; outputs reproducible from supplied C programs.
scientific_limitations: Only unmarked embedded pencils over F2; the classification is not one of abstract genus-one curves or larger finite fields. Historical unindexed catalogues may contain equivalent information.
title: Eight projective orbit types of smooth elliptic quartic intersections over \(\mathbf F_2\)
